question: A ball falls for 1 s. Its bounces last 1.6 s, then 0.8 times as long each time. Total time before it stops, in seconds?
move: Count the steps and the time separately; endless steps can fit in seconds.
trap: Assuming infinitely many bounces must take an infinite time.
hint: Add the endless bounces as one shrinking series, then add the fall.
steps: A shrinking series sums to first term / (1 - ratio).
source: Lee & Seshia, Introduction to Embedded Systems
reference: Lee & Seshia, Introduction to Embedded Systems: A Cyber-Physical Systems Approach, 2nd ed., MIT Press, 2017
